_comment: EVA agent registry — the single source of truth for every lobe Diracatron can orchestrate. Adding a lobe is a config edit here: add an object with slug/name/port/host/health/actions/capabilities and (optionally) a cli block. registry.py loads this file; no code change needed. Ports mirror EVA_AGENT_CATALOG.md.

agents.name: Context API (logger)
agents.capabilities: Reads real-time activity/context (screen, calendar, week/day/patterns). Use to gather situational awareness before acting; never a write target.

agents.name: Deal Scout
agents.capabilities: Sources, scores (v6 11-param), and gates SaaS/content acquisition targets; produces buy-vs-build recommendations. Invoke to score pending deals or pull the scored shortlist of open doors.

agents.name: Content Engine
agents.capabilities: Generates on-voice content drafts from activity + briefs. Invoke to produce drafts for approval; never auto-posts (social-scheduler gates posting).

agents.name: Launcher / Control Plane
agents.capabilities: Start/stop/health-check services and front port-less gates (social-publish, Apollo->GHL). Port-less agents are dispatched through here.

agents.name: Eva State Ledger
agents.capabilities: Append-only governed ledger of every decision/outcome + derived state (pending-approvals, open-blockers, today). Diracatron logs every dispatch here so Eva learns.

agents.name: Channels
agents.capabilities: Composes and publishes to social/messaging channels via connectors with an approval ledger. Invoke to compose or tick the publish loop.

agents.name: Knowledge
agents.capabilities: Serves playbooks and knowledge-base context/docs. Use to fetch grounding context or append learnings.

agents.name: Voice
agents.capabilities: Wake-word + speech surface. Invoke to speak a summary aloud or issue a voice command.

agents.name: GHL Agent
agents.capabilities: Captures/nurtures leads and builds funnels in GoHighLevel. Invoke on new leads or broker replies to capture and advance them.

agents.name: Treasurer (Finance Tracker)
agents.capabilities: Tracks spend, budgets, and burn; flags budget breaches. Invoke to record spend, check a budget before a costly action, or pull the burn/summary.

agents.name: Social Scheduler
agents.capabilities: Approves-per-post and publishes the content schedule; syncs analytics. Invoke to run the schedule, seed drafts, or sync metrics.

agents.name: Deployer
agents.capabilities: Detects changed modules and restarts/redeploys services (incl. landing). Invoke to check for and apply pending deploys.

agents.name: Local Exec
agents.capabilities: Runs allowlisted local ops (git, loopback curl, service restart, vercel prod, env token swaps); anything else is gated behind Slack approval. Loopback-only. Invoke for safe local automation.

agents.name: IP Scout
agents.capabilities: Mines activity for patentable inventions, scans prior art (PatentsView), and drafts invention disclosures. Invoke to seed an idea or run a prior-art scan.

agents.name: Brand Builder
agents.capabilities: Brand strategy layer above content-engine: writes content briefs from pipelines+blueprints (never posts). Invoke to plan a weekly brief set or queue briefs to content-engine.

agents.name: Idea Generator Agent
agents.capabilities: Scores new venture/product ideas against the goal (Storeys RE PE fund + Mangotec AI-agency revenue) and existing portfolio synergy; computes BUILD/PARTNER/WATCH/PASS + acquire-instead-of-build flags; raises devil's-advocate flags (unverified demand, shiny-object drift, missing counter-thesis). Also runs a daily system-wide alignment/red-flag digest over eva-state activity. Invoke to score a new idea or pull the review queue/history.

agents.name: Trend Agent
agents.capabilities: Macro-thesis stress-test engine: takes sourced sector sub-scores (historical resilience, AI disruption exposure, structural demand), computes a weighted durability score per sector, and returns a SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED / REFUTED verdict for a strategic thesis (e.g. the basic-needs RE thesis) over a multi-year horizon. Emits thesis_run_completed always, and thesis_refuted (near-alignment-flag priority) when a thesis fails its own pass threshold, so Diracatron surfaces a macro footing problem before more capital/time goes in on a bad premise.
